changes.title: Wider cloaks
items: Cloaks are a little wider, and flare out like a cape the longer they get
The cowboy, conical, musketeer, party and mushroom hats' glowing bands show when she stands, too

changes.title: Legend circle explainer
items: Step into a sleeping legend's circle and a note beside it explains it: the sigil it dreams of for a boon, a relic for a powerful ally, and what makes it restless; it changes when the legend is restless, angry or your ally

changes.title: Invite ring
items: Every 💌 that lands on a creature now joins a ring orbiting it: the gaps show how many more it needs, a full ring turns to rising ❤️s as it's won over, and left alone the envelopes fall out of orbit one by one
Every 💌 hit counts now: no more hits ignored for landing too soon after the last
